caption:
Not your average Pizza / Pasta Sauce
I will share my classic tomato sauce recipe soon :) 

Ingredients: 
* 1 tsp olive oil
* 8-10 garlic cloves, finely chopped
* one tin, canned San Marzano tomatoes ( whole or puree)
* 2 tsp sugar
* salt, to taste
* Handful of basil leaves,  chopped ( I add a whole sprig too)
* 2 tsp black pepper
* 1 tsp red chilli powder
* 1 sachet tomato ketchup 
* Water, if needed 

Method: 
~ add oil to the pan. once warm, add the garlic and fry for a minute but do not let it brown.
~Pour the can of tomatoes in the pan ( before i add the tomatoes to the pan, i like to crush them with my hand to break it down, you can use a masher or allow them to cook and use your spoon to crush as well)
~follow up by adding the rest of your ingredients 
~ simmer on a low heat for 20 minutes until the sauce is slightly thick and has a more depth of flavour ( i prefer to allow my sauce to simmer on low heat with a lid as it does tend to bubble and can splatter and burn((been there done that)) )
~allow the sauce to cool at room tempreture before using on your pizza or just add pasta to it while hot 
~this sauce will stay g for upto a week in the fridge or three months frozen
